title: ENGINE - DESCRIPTION AND OPERATION
question: What is the purpose of staggering the cylinders in Textron Lycoming's 10-540 AB1A5 and TIO-540-AK1A engines, and how does this arrangement affect the crankshaft design?
answer: 1.Description and OperationTextron Lycomning's 10-540 ABlA5 and TIO-540-AKlA are direct drive, six cylinder, fuel injected, horizontally opposed, air cooled engines. The cylinders, numbered from front to rear, are staggered to permit a separate throw on the crankshaft for each connecting rod. The right front cylinder is number 1 and the other cylinders on the right side of the engine are identified by odd numbers 3 and 5.
